title: Enforce SSL for an S3 Bucket
description: Write a bucket policy that denies any request not using HTTPS.
problemStatement:
Write an S3 bucket policy (JSON) that explicitly denies any `s3:GetObject` or `s3:PutObject` request that is not transmitted over SSL (HTTPS). The bucket name is `confidential-data`.

Include an explicit deny statement with a condition using `aws:SecureTransport`. Explain what happens if a user tries to access the bucket via HTTP.

Also, what additional step would you take to enforce encryption at rest on this bucket?
hints: Resource should be bucket and objects.
To enforce encryption at rest, add another deny for uploads without `s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption` header or enable default encryption.
